data.description: Deliberately small direct-manipulation editor for layered and grouped SVG mockups. Supports selection, group selection, drag, resize, inline label editing, add, edit, delete, duplicate, group, ungroup, front and back ordering, a small primitive palette, undo and redo, and Snipping Tool style red-pencil annotations with eraser and optional text callouts. It does not provide responsive constraints, application interactions, prototyping, or code generation.
data.name: Layered SVG Mockup Editor
data.technology: React, TypeScript, SVG DOM, Pointer Events
